reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-02 restores the source's dark tilted outer frame and removes the prior metal clip. The note has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row, no third row, and largely blank lower paper. The yellow mascot retains a near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze and restrained closed-mouth half-smile. The dark olive cap has a shiny black visor, gold piping/cord and two separated gold front emblems; dark eyebrows remain, with no glasses, moustache or beard. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder braid, two red collar patches with pale/gold detailing and one black-and-silver cross at the throat. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The opaque grey-beige photographic backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap/collar embroidery, the tiny neck-cross detail and note lettering are not reliably readable at 65x67. These fine uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the restored dark frame, absent clip and two-by-two note layout are directly visible.
